title: Multi-talented artist, Ka Lia Universe is making waves with her latest release “I Deserve Better”
htmlContent:
American-based artist Ka Lia Universe is an emerging figure to be reckoned with. She is a talented singer and songwriter who first discovered her love for music while participating in the school choir, jamming with Britney Spears, and listening to Alicia Keys's records in her free time. She displays her passion and zeal for music in the release of her recent track "I Deserve Better."

In her recent track, "I Deserve Better," Ka Lia Universe talks about how her long-term relationship ended and how rough it was for her. After her break up, Ka Lia Universe decided she needed a new musical style to symbolize her rebirth and leave the past behind. Here she enters her first full rap song and castigates her former lover bar for over 3 minutes & 26 seconds. Realizing her worth and seeing the compromises made and faults that only hindsight will allow you to.
